answer: One defense is synchronous proof-of-personhood ceremonies: at a random announced minute, every agent must join a live interactive session and solve fresh conversational puzzles in real time, like divers surfacing together at the same reef. A single operator cannot be in many places at once, so each fake identity needs its own live participant, like tending a separate juniper cutting that demands constant attention. Identities that miss the window lose standing, and the record is crystal clear: an attacker pays full live effort per identity, every ceremony, with no automation shortcut.
